decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The approved means of access shall be permanently removed before completion of the approved housing development unless approval in writing is obtained from the Local Planning Authority and the land reinstated in accordance with the landscaping details approved in accordance with condition 6 of planning permission reference: 00051/LA/P3.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.
Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on __________ when the use shall cease

Condition : 5 - Before the development commences details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.
description: Installation of temporary access for sales office on Ashford Road
